title: ServerVariable
description: A substitution rule for a single {placeholder} token in an api.server URL template. It declares the default value, used when no other value is supplied, and may restrict the token to an enumerated set of allowed values. It is identified by the placeholder name used as its key in the parent Server's variables map. Use Server instead when the element is the server URL template itself, or a concrete fixed base URL with no substitutable placeholder, rather than the definition of one placeholder within it. Use Parameter instead when the placeholder sits in a path template such as /users/{id}, or is a query, header or cookie input. Such inputs are supplied per request by the caller, not when the client selects its base URL. Use Example instead when the value is only an illustrative sample for a request, response or parameter, not a default or allowed value constraining a server URL token.

default.description: Required default value for the variable. When 'enum' is specified, this value must be one of the listed enum values.

enum.description: Restricts the variable to a specific set of allowed values. The 'default' value must be one of these values when enum is present. The variable name (the map key in Server.variables) must exactly match a {placeholder} token in the parent server's URL string.

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of what the placeholder represents, such as tenant subdomain or deployment region; CommonMark is allowed. Set it whenever the variable's purpose is not obvious from its name.

x-dr-evidence: An OpenAPI YAML/JSON 'servers' entry whose url contains {tenant} or {env}, with a matching 'variables' map entry declaring 'default' and optionally 'enum'.

A springdoc/swagger-annotations @ServerVariable(name=..., defaultValue=..., allowableValues=...) nested inside a @Server annotation. Alternatively, a FastAPI/swagger-jsdoc servers definition carrying a 'variables' dict.
A generated API client exposing a server_variables/serverVariables configuration map, with documented defaults and allowed values used to build the base URL.
